open_questions: Recorded 2026-10-02 from a scan of the archive (scripts/delivery_signal_scan.py): 16 deliveries reported by Фонд «Наша Правда» (an institutional donor) between 2025-02-11 and 2026-05-19. Each is the donor's own report, so credibility is single; the post date is the report date, not the handover date; the version is never stated; recipients are recorded at the level of unit, region or direction the donor names, never a town or a person. NOT recorded: handovers by volunteer groups and individuals (about 20 more texts in the scan, e.g. Архангел Спецназа, «Судоплатов», «Тыл-22»), and 3mx's own handovers (to the Kursk fighters with Покров, 28.04.2025; to Э. Запашный, 30.10.2025), The user decided on 02.10.2026: towns are allowed as recipients, everyone involved is a person of interest, and volunteer reports default to self-report. These handovers can now be recorded; they are not recorded yet.

РОЙ.МАРКЕТ: the maker's rep says the product is sold only on 3mx.ru and through dealers (s8860, 02.09.2026). No РОЙ.МАРКЕТ listing of «Булат» is documented; the 2026-10-01 self-report sweep found 3mx saying it does not sell there.
The two WB brand-store listings and the product versions' dates have no archived capture of the marketplace page (source_id null above); capture them before relying on them.
Mapping a dealer's listing to a version needs the dealer's own product page; only the maker's own pages (s8018-s8020) and the user manuals are read.

Recorded 2026-10-02 (lead, not read in full): post 15100 in the maker's customer chat (s8749, 03.10.2024) is a buyer's screenshot of a message from «Крылья Победы | Магазин» offering «Булат» V4 from stock. The seller has no record and no identity; seen only at thumbnail size. Read the screenshot at full size and look for the shop's channel before any listing or seller record.

B3 (02.10.2026): where Фонд «Наша Правда» bought its «Булат» is not documented. Its 2024 accounts show 50 units in stock for transfer to units (claim above) but name no supplier; the only supplier named in its creditor breakdown at 31.12.2024 is АО «Технодрон» (₽982.6 thousand), with nothing tying it to «Булат». The brief's НПО «Милитех» lead is the maker of headsets in the same list, not of «Булат». Next: the fund's procurement or a supplier's own post naming the fund.
